summary: Compact Noether R121 Paper 14 no-duplicate audit. It verifies that known RA55, RA64, and RA78 Paper 14 changes are already visible in R121, so those patches should not be replayed onto the current cumulative.
verification_summary: R121 contains the P14 article boundary with footnote reset.
R121 contains the visible numbered P14 title.
R121 contains the RA64/RA55 p190 correction: mod. (z-c) in Linearfaktoren.
R121 contains the RA55 p198 correction with frp_1^{rho_1}...frp_sigma^{rho_sigma}, not the erroneous e_1...rho.
R121 contains the RA55 p200 correction calA calN^rho and calB calN^sigma, not nu/nu-prime.
R121 preserves sampled P14 no-fix traps checked here.
limitations: No new TeX patch is included.
No source images, reader PDFs, or translations are included.
RA64 source-checked only printed pp.182-194 through section 5; section 6 onward was deferred in that tranche.
RA55 contains targeted later fixes on printed pp.198 and 200, but does not certify surrounding later pages globally.
Local source-quality ledgers report P14 source below the later 650 PPI floor; this verifies survival of accepted repairs rather than fresh dense-math certification.
Not P14 closure, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
recommended_next_action: Use as a compact skip/anti-duplication guardrail for active Noether web work. Upload only as coordination/provenance evidence if useful; do not present it as reader output or source closure.
